action.description: Structured operation. Prefer this over the legacy command field.

notebook.description: Notebook name or id; defaults to the current notebook where supported.

address.description: Note or canvas address: <notebook>::<relative-path>, or an absolute path (show, edit, write, delete, columns.*, background.*, callout.*, toggle.*, canvas.*).

historyId.description: Cloud history id for cloud.restore, taken from cloud.versions.

tag.description: Optional tag path filter. Matches the path itself and all sub-tags; a leading # is accepted (for example 项目/Flowix).

content.description: Complete Markdown, replacement body, artifact source, callout body for callout.add, or toggle body for toggle.add/set.

old.description: Exact text that must occur once for edit.

collectionId.description: Stable collection identity. Provide this or path for collection.read.

path.description: Notebook-relative collection file path. Provide this or collectionId for collection.read.

count.description: Number of empty columns to insert for columns.add.

at.description: 1-based line to insert before; defaults to the end of the note (columns.add, callout.add and toggle.add).

block.description: 1-based block index for columns.remove, columns.width, callout.set/remove and toggle.set/remove.

widths.description: Relative column width weights, one per column.

line.description: 1-based Markdown line whose text block receives or clears the background (background.set and background.clear).

color.description: Background color for background.set, callout.add/set and toggle.add/set; sticky tint for canvas.addCard.

icon.description: Callout icon (an emoji character). callout.add defaults to 💡.

title.description: Title line for toggle.add/set. Empty titles are allowed; the body stays in the collapsible section. Also the card title snapshot for canvas.addCard.

open.description: Toggle fold state for toggle.add (default true) or toggle.set (omit to keep the current state).

clearBg.description: For toggle.set: remove the container background instead of setting one.

keepContent.description: For callout.remove and toggle.remove: keep the container content as plain blocks (default) instead of deleting it with the container.

name.description: Canvas name (filename stem) for canvas.create; defaults to Untitled.

note.description: Note address (<notebook>::<path>) to place on the canvas as a note card (canvas.addCard).

notes.description: Note addresses placed as a grid of note cards (canvas.addNotes).

text.description: Sticky text content for canvas.addCard, or the shape label for canvas.addShape.

from.description: Existing card/shape id the edge starts at (canvas.addEdge).

to.description: Existing card/shape id the edge ends at (canvas.addEdge).

fill.description: Shape background paint, e.g. #ffffff or transparent (canvas.addShape).

ids.description: Element ids to remove (canvas.remove); connected edges are removed too.

x.description: Left edge of the new element in flow coordinates; omitted auto-places beside existing content.

y.description: Top edge of the new element in flow coordinates; omitted auto-places beside existing content.

w.description: Element width; defaults to the element's board size (note 420, sticky 220, shape 160, label 240, frame 480).

h.description: Element height; defaults to the element's board size.

x2.description: Arrow/line head X (canvas.addShape); defaults to x + 160.

y2.description: Arrow/line head Y (canvas.addShape); defaults to y.

command.description: Legacy restricted CLI command without the flowix prefix.
